133. Sum of Consecutive Pairs

40

Medium  Topics

Problem Statement:
Given a number N and an array of N elements, find the sum of the sums obtained by considering all consecutive pairs of adjacent elements.
input_spec: The input consists of a number N and an array of N elements. N <= 100000.
output_spec: The output is the sum of the sums obtained by considering all consecutive pairs of adjacent elements.
